visual_readback.donor_optical_depth.png: Source title is derived from saved provenance and currently reads R15 emissivity. The exact-zero initial electron sample is excluded from the log axis and annotated; tau retains its target-clock label.
visual_readback.species_evolution.png: Existing redshift evolution retained with readable magnitude/signed labels, axes and legend; all displayed curves span the actual20to4 support.

donor_closure: R15 emissivity; HG97 Case-B; Q filling factor; HII+HeII inside; neutral outside; T=20000K; C=3; HeIII=0; no residual electrons
donor_title_policy: Saved provenance label/name/model or first closure clause; no hardcoded R15 scientific label.
zero_annotation_policy: Emitted only when the selected saved first ne_cm3 value equals exactly0.

elapsed_time.time_source: stored elapsed_s for each receiver trajectory; subtract its first value; no new background integral

paired_difference_grid: exact shared saved redshift; no interpolation

endpoint_projection.reason: The actual campaign contains only one donor-on result. No artificial or pending cases were rendered.
endpoint_projection.future_output: plots/endpoint_projections.png and .svg when at least2 validated donor-on cases are supplied
endpoint_projection.color: signed initial P_r with symmetric diverging scale, or a fixed color when all initial P_r are zero
endpoint_projection.verification: source readback only; no multi-case visual check claimed

limitations: Current saved results coverz20to4 only; these figures do not establish a z20to2 H/He donor.
This is a saved-data/plot packaging review, not independent scientific admission of the paired experiment. That result review is separate.
Small recorded differences are displayed without asserting independently converged physical significance.
Sweep endpoint rendering is implemented but not exercised on future pending pilot18/joint175 cases.
The consumer requires every case declared by the supplied campaign to validate as completed; it does not invent missing trajectories.
No runtime/doc version-equality claim or performance factor is made.
